name: Cats
overview: Scripture acknowledges God's sovereign creation of all living creatures, including beasts like cats, as part of His design for the earth (Genesis 1:24). The Bible also highlights the responsibility of the righteous to care compassionately for their animals, reflecting God's heart for all life (Proverbs 12:10). Additionally, imagery involving beasts such as the leopard in Daniel 7:6 symbolizes authority and dominion, reminding us that all creatures fall under God's ultimate rule.
